left.raw_text: 1. Patients who previously received anti-programmed death receptor-1 (PD-1) antibody, anti-programmed death ligand-1 (PD-L1) antibody, anti-programmed death ligand-2 (PD-L2) antibody or anti-cytotoxic T lymphocyte-associated antigen-4 (CTLA-4) antibodies, including those who have participated in a JS001 clinical study;

right.raw_text: 2. Patients who previously received any TACE, radiofrequency ablation and other liver cancer treatments;

left.raw_text: 3. Patients with a history of gastroesophageal varices or active cardia ulcers associated with a high risk of bleeding;

right.raw_text: 4. Patients who have upper gastrointestinal hemorrhage within 1 year;
